reading: The report says Jensen Huang has left his job as the leader of Nvidia.
He left after reports about relationships with people other than his wife.
US politicians want to ask him questions about a possible Chinese spy.
A spy secretly collects information for another country.
Nvidia has promised to check all the information it can get.
The company makes computer chips, small parts that help computers work.
Colette Kress is the company's leader for now.
She called an emergency meeting to talk about the company's future.
Nvidia is looking for a new leader.

Things you ask when you want answers.
To look at something carefully to learn more about it.
